data.name: Kharsan
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'khassanah' which means 'a fortified place', 'a stronghold' or 'a strong fort'. It can also be derived from the Persian word 'kharshan' which means 'a solid rock'. This name evokes images of strength, fortitude, and protection.

in_urdu.name: خرسان
in_urdu.long_meaning: خرسان نام علم مذکر ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے بلند جبل یا اعلیٰ پہاڑ۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے اور اس کا تعلق جبل سے ہے جو عظیم الشان اور بلند مقام رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ख़र्सान
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़र्सान एक मस्कुलिन नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है उच्च या महान पर्वत। यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में महत्वपूर्ण है और इसकी जड़ें अरबी भाषा में हैं।

in_pashto.name: خرسان
in_pashto.long_meaning: خرسان د علم مذکر نوم دی چی د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دغه نوم د لوړ یا ستر غر معنی لري. دا نوم د افغانانو او پښتنو په کلتور کې د پام وړ دی.

in_english.name: Kharsan
in_english.long_meaning: Kharsan is a masculine given name of Arabic origin, meaning 'high mountain' or 'elevated peak'. It is derived from the Arabic root 'خ ر س' which relates to mountains or elevated areas. The name signifies strength, grandeur, and elevation, reflecting the importance of mountains in Islamic culture and geography.

This name is often given to children to instill within them a sense of strength, resilience, and the ability to withstand life's challenges, just like a fort or a stronghold.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name "Kharsan" holds a deep spiritual significance as it reminds us of the protection and guidance of Allah (God). Just as a fortress provides physical security to its inhabitants, Kharsan implies the strength and security that comes from having a strong relationship with God. It encourages us to seek refuge in Allah during times of hardship and to trust in His protection and guidance. Thus, the name Kharsan serves as a reminder of the ultimate security and mercy provided by Allah, and the importance of building a strong spiritual fortress within ourselves.
